label: Aruba CX 6300M 24SFP+ 4SFP56 (JL658A)
description: Aruba CX 6300M 24SFP+ 4SFP56 (JL658A) - 1RU fibre access/aggregation switch (AOS-CX): 24x 1G/10G SFP+ cages (1/1/1-1/1/24) plus 4x SFP56 uplink/stacking cages (1/1/25-1/1/28), modelled at the 1/10/25G rates the engine's SFP56 cage carries (the hardware also runs 50G). No copper access ports: the RJ-45 variants are different SKUs.
